_comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — this is not a live FMCSA response and no number in it is a
fact about any real carrier. It is the exact body fed to the app to record
docs/demo.gif, served from a local stub in place of the QCMobile API. The
field names and shapes follow the documentation at mobile.fmcsa.dot.gov/QCDevsite;
the values are invented to exercise three rendering paths at once: a null
safetyRating (rendered as a note, not a warning), a driver out-of-service rate
above the national average on only 3 inspections (suppressed, below the 5-
inspection floor), and a vehicle out-of-service rate above the national average
on 9 inspections (flagged). FAST LINE LOGISTICS LLC / USDOT 4581509 is the
author's own carrier and is used as the subject so that no third party is
bipdRequiredAmount is deliberately absent: whether QCMobile sends that field in
dollars or in thousands is not yet confirmed against the live API, so the demo
does not display a number it cannot vouch for.
